scope.transport: Trusted same-Unix-user local CLI; MCP transport not implemented

invariants.predicate: Identity comes from a trusted local launcher, never tool request arguments.
invariants.falsifier: Missing/forged request binding refused; cooperative Unix boundary explicit.

invariants.predicate: Only implemented bounded read operations are dispatchable.
invariants.falsifier: query_doctor and query_saplan positive; every mutation/unknown tool refused.

invariants.predicate: Canonical task must be executing for bound worker and attempt, with completed dependencies.
invariants.falsifier: Wrong owner, attempt, blocked or terminal task refused.

invariants.predicate: Canonical coordinator task lease must match session and epoch in current boot.
invariants.falsifier: Missing/released/wrong epoch and boot continuity failure refused.
invariants.limits: Positive current epoch observed; complete forged-boot and epoch fault-injection matrix not repeated in this slice.

invariants.predicate: Fresh clock and sufficient task/coordinator lease windows must surround execution.
invariants.falsifier: Authority change during observation discards output; no success after expiry.
invariants.limits: Before/after production fences and post-fence failure unit tested; host-clock discontinuity injection not performed.

invariants.predicate: Tool arguments cannot select a DB, path, command, authority or arbitrary SQL.
invariants.falsifier: Only strict empty object accepted; malformed/oversized/extra fields refused.

invariants.predicate: Reports distinguish policy, observed task state and unobserved runtime health.
invariants.falsifier: Doctor ceiling93, unknown counts/purity; no simulated mutation success.

invariants.predicate: Bounded read repeats may reobserve and never claim exactly-once effects.
invariants.falsifier: Repeated observations do not mutate task authority or external services.

invariants.predicate: Sa-plan results and private message payloads are absent from public task responses.
invariants.falsifier: Only scoped non-sensitive identifiers/states/counts; sanitized errors.

invariants.predicate: Exact source, artifact and loaded runtime are independently reviewed before main advancement.
invariants.falsifier: Source candidate and immutable release identity match observed process.

authority: Executable bounded invariant evidence; not exhaustive proof, IAM, transport admission or global system admission.
